title: The first path survives departures and restarts

steps.text: Playable line 1 uses the v09-rail clean break. Old t1v02 writers stay in different rooms; their saves are not migrated. The isolated t1v01 spine and T1 personal claim keys remain.
The server binds each request to player identity and session epoch. Reach and cadence are host facts; bounded receipts prevent duplicate spending.

A verified checkpoint and ordered future queue become durable before publication. Failed writes pause production; failed loads never become fresh progress. Only funded jobs advance during bounded offline completion.

One beam has a location, holder epoch and revision. Departure or restart releases an orphan to its source anchor. A stale release cannot steal a new claim, and accepted T3 delivery defeats later recovery.

Slow accepted renewal counts every new stone unit. The three-departed-carrier witness keeps all 24 original stone on their backs, renews spent rocks and lets a visitor complete T2 without confiscation.

Drops age into the courtyard rack by material. Reload rebuilds cargo, station phases and earned world facts quietly; the existing personal lock keeps each T1/T2 claim and cosmetic in one atomic write.
